english.title: Insurance company fail to make required returns to London Fire Commissioner
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an insurance company, made default in making a return to the London Fire Commissioner as required by the Metropolitan Fire Brigade Act 1865 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF DEFAULT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16 of the Metropolitan Fire Brigade Act 1865.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
insurance company made default
in making returns to the London Fire Commissioner
as required by
Metropolitan Fire Brigade Act 1865

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 328(7) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999 provides that references to the London Fire and Civil Defence Authority shall be read as references to the London Fire and Emergency Planning Authority.
(ii) As of 1st April 2018, the London Fire and Emergency Planning Authority has been abolished and its functions transferred to the London Fire Commissioner.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being an insurance company, made default in making a return to the London Fire Commissioner as required by the Metropolitan Fire Brigade Act 1865 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF DEFAULT..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding not exceeding five pounds for every day during which the insurance company is in default.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
